title: loft · circle to rectangle
description: A smooth transition from a circle to a rectangle.
source:
import { b } from '@tscircuit/b123-fiber'

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <b.BuildPart>
      <b.BuildSketch>
        <b.Circle radius={10} />
      </b.BuildSketch>
      <b.BuildSketch args={[{ "$call": "Plane", "kwargs": { "origin": [0, 0, 15] } }]}>
        <b.Rectangle width={10} height={10} />
      </b.BuildSketch>
      <b.loft />
    </b.BuildPart>
  )
}

title: sweep · curved pipe
description: A circular profile swept along a captured 3D spline.
source:
import { b } from '@tscircuit/b123-fiber'

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <b.BuildPart>
      <b.BuildSketch args={[b.Plane.YZ]}>
        <b.Circle radius={2} />
      </b.BuildSketch>
      <b.BuildLine id={"sweep-path"}>
        <b.Spline args={[[0, 0, 0], [8, 0, 2], [14, 8, 5], [20, 10, 10]]} />
      </b.BuildLine>
      <b.sweep path={{ "$ref": "sweep-path" }} />
    </b.BuildPart>
  )
}

source:
import { b, Group, Subtract } from '@tscircuit/b123-fiber'

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Group>
      <Subtract color={"#347357"} name={"PCB"}>
        <b.Box length={48} width={32} height={1.6} />
        <b.Cylinder radius={1.6} height={4} position={[-20, -12, 0]} />
        <b.Cylinder radius={1.6} height={4} position={[-20, 12, 0]} />
        <b.Cylinder radius={1.6} height={4} position={[20, -12, 0]} />
        <b.Cylinder radius={1.6} height={4} position={[20, 12, 0]} />
      </Subtract>
      <b.Box length={17} width={10} height={4} color={"#353c49"} name={"Controller"} position={[0, 0, 2.8]} />
      <b.Box length={12} width={10} height={7} color={"#9da5af"} name={"USB shell"} position={[19, 0, 4.3]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin -1-0"} position={[-14, -11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin -1-1"} position={[-10, -11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin -1-2"} position={[-6, -11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin -1-3"} position={[-2, -11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin -1-4"} position={[2, -11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin -1-5"} position={[6, -11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin -1-6"} position={[10, -11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin -1-7"} position={[14, -11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin 1-0"} position={[-14, 11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin 1-1"} position={[-10, 11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin 1-2"} position={[-6, 11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin 1-3"} position={[-2, 11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin 1-4"} position={[2, 11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin 1-5"} position={[6, 11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin 1-6"} position={[10, 11, 4.8]} />
      <b.Box length={1.4} width={1.4} height={8} color={"#dbc37c"} name={"Pin 1-7"} position={[14, 11, 4.8]} />
    </Group>
  )
}
